 The Florida A&M Rattlers (2–5) welcome the Arkansas–Pine Bluff Golden Lions (3–3) to Bragg Memorial Stadium in Tallahassee, Florida , on Saturday, Oct. 24, for a Southwestern Athletic Conference (SWAC) showdown that doubles as the Rattlers’ annual Homecoming celebration.
 Both teams enter with identical 1–2 conference records and plenty to play for as the NCAA Division I FCS season enters its final stretch.
 Rattlers looking to capitalize on homecoming atmosphere
 Florida A&M returns home following a 27–17 defeat to Jackson State , a game the Rattlers led 17–12 entering the fourth quarter.
 Running back Jamal Hailey provided a spark, rushing for 111 yards on just 12 carries, including an 81-yard touchdown. The performance helped FAMU produce a season-high 164 rushing yards.
 Quarterback Armond Parker has thrown for 925 yards and eight touchdowns, while explosive receiver Armand Burris averages 27.7 yards per reception, including an 89-yard touchdown against Alabama State .
 That passing attack could find opportunities against a Golden Lions defense surrendering a SWAC-high 311.2 passing yards per game.
 Watch live. Arkansas–Pine Bluff Golden Lions @ Florida A&M Rattlers, Oct. 24, 21:00 CEST (9 pm, 3 pm ET) (Requires a VPN outside of USA)
 Golden Lions bring dangerous offense
 Arkansas–Pine Bluff arrives following a narrow 21–15 loss to Alabama State , but the Golden Lions have demonstrated considerable offensive firepower this season.
 Averaging 32.8 points and 395.2 yards per game, UAPB ranks third in the SWAC in rushing offense at 208.3 yards per contest.
 Running back Za’Marion Webber averages an impressive 7.6 yards per carry, while quarterback Garrison Davis has thrown 11 touchdown passes.
 Receiver Demetric Whitlock Jr. has accumulated 448 yards and five touchdowns, with D’Avery Robinson adding six touchdown receptions.
 Florida A&M defense could make the difference
 Despite its losing record, Florida A&M features several defensive standouts.
 Linebacker Denzel Johnson leads the SWAC with 11.9 tackles per game, while Antonio Camon has recorded six tackles for loss.
 Safety Justin Bostic has three interceptions, and the Rattlers rank second in the conference in third-down defense, allowing conversions on just 32.5 percent of attempts.
 Homecoming and conference positioning at stake
 Florida A&M holds a perfect 3–0 series record against Arkansas–Pine Bluff , including last season’s 31–28 victory.
 With both teams seeking to climb the SWAC standings, Saturday’s matchup offers the Rattlers an opportunity to celebrate Homecoming with a much-needed victory, while the Golden Lions aim to spoil the festivities and return to winning form.
